description: Declarations written in YAML that convert to JSON and then fail validation, with the issues of the stage that reports them.

cases.description: A version of another MINOR line.

issues.message: Version '0.2.0' at /vocabulary is not supported. This release reads version 0.1.x.

cases.description: The version '0.1', which stays a string and is not supported.

issues.message: Version '0.1' at /vocabulary is not supported. This release reads version 0.1.x.

cases.description: A units block written as the scalar 'none', which stays a string and fails the type of the block.
An observation block written as the scalar '5', which is a string where an object is required.
A creation time written as a date, which stays a string and fails the pattern of a UTC timestamp.

issues.message: The string at /provenance/created is not a valid UTC timestamp.

cases.description: The unknown keys 'yes' and 'outcome_blind'. Their values stay strings, so there is no E3008.

issues.message: Unknown key 'outcome_blind' in the object at (root).
Unknown key 'yes' in the object at (root).

cases.description: The faulty declaration of the Reporting section of declarations.md in YAML, with its four issues from stage 5.

issues.message: The estimands at /estimands include no focal estimand, which a minimal declaration requires.
The feature 'longitudinal' at /features/1 requires '/observation/time' to be declared.
The outcome column 'post' cannot be used at /observation/key/4.
The column 'arm' is in the assignment block, so its role at /variables/arm/role must be 'assigned'.
